prompt: Choose the best sentence for the blank.
promptZh: 請選出最適合填入空格的句子。

options.text: Show your registration message at the entrance even if your name is not on the list.
options.zh: 即使名單沒有你的名字，也可在入口出示報名訊息。
options.whyZh: 原文說報名訊息只代表收件；確定有名額要以星期五名單為準。

options.text: Ask your supervisor to confirm your place before the instructor prepares the list.
options.zh: 講師準備名單前，請主管先確認你的名額。
options.whyZh: 主管能代報名，但不能在講師確認教室容量前替學員保證名額。

options.text: Wait until Friday to register so the instructor knows how many names to list.
options.zh: 等星期五再報名，這樣講師才知道應列幾個名字。
options.whyZh: 報名最遲於星期四；星期五寄出的是已獲名額的名單。

options.text: Check that list before making plans to attend.
options.zh: 請先確認名單，再安排是否出席。
options.whyZh: that list 指前句的星期五名單；後句也說在名單上才要準備空盒。

explanationZh: that list 指前句的星期五名單；後句也說在名單上才要準備空盒。

vocabulary.note: 列出確定有名額、可以參加的人。

evidence:
To: Shop-floor staff
Subject: May packaging workshop

Please register through the portal by Thursday. Supervisors may enter names for staff who do not have portal access.

A registration message confirms that we received your request. It does not mean your place has been reserved. The instructor will send a seating list on Friday after checking the room size. Check that list before making plans to attend.

If your name is on the list, bring one empty sample box. Extra practice materials are available at the door. These materials are free of charge.
